messages:
carla: quick sync: we need a single contract for "soft degrade" signals so routing, billing, SDKs, and console are consistent. options: change HTTP status, header+body, stream control-frame, or mandatory telemetry event. thoughts?

ben: do NOT rely on 2xx for anything that should trigger automated fallback. infra tools, proxies, and customer health checks assume HTTP buckets.

mike: emitting a telemetry event is lowest-impact to existing infra. we can add routing consumers to act on that event. must define low-cardinality keys for alerts.

sophia: SDKs need deterministic surface. proposal: runtime emits X-Runtime-Degrade header + body.error and ALWAYS emits telemetry event. SDKs parse header when client supports it, otherwise server-side dashboards still show the event.

console-ux: console wants badge states (ok / soft-degraded / failing), sampled scrubbed prompts, and link to runbook. sampling limits: 50 samples per route per 10m, prefer unique tenants.

finance-anna: billing note: customers should be billed for delivered tokens; any credit policy for truncated responses to be decided with finance/legal.

ben: alerting rule idea: alert when rate(soft_degrade_events[5m]) > threshold AND distinct_tenants > N. avoids noisy single-tenant spikes.

mike: implement routing_hint in the event (none|fallback_recommended|immediate_failover) so routers don't need to change HTTP semantics.

carla: rollout plan: alpha internal (event + header), beta (SDK opt-in + console badge), GA (server enforces event emission and SDKs default parse).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: carla posted rfc/soft-degrade-v1 for review (reviewers: @mike @ben @sophia).

carla: action items: mike -> telemetry producer PR, ben -> alerting/dashboards, sophia -> SDK parsing api + version gate, console-ux -> badge mockups, finance-anna -> billing edge cases. I'll author RFC with schema and prom rules. End.
